question: The average of 19 numbers is 46. The average of the first 5 numbers is 49 and the average of the next 6 numbers is 54. What is the average of the remaining numbers? (Correct to one decimal place)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the Net Deviation method from the total average (46):

Total deviation of first 5 numbers = 5 × (49 − 46) = +15

Total deviation of next 6 numbers = 6 × (54 − 46) = +48

Combined deviation of these 11 numbers = +15 + 48 = +63

To balance the total average, the remaining 8 numbers must contribute a deviation of −63.

Average of remaining numbers = 46 − (63 ÷ 8) = 46 − 7.875 = 38.125 ≈ 38.1

**∴ The correct answer is 38.1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total numbers = 19, Average = 46

First 5 numbers, Average = 49

Next 6 numbers, Average = 54

**Formula Used:**

Sum of observations = Average × Number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d8d4ffdd98d22ce0986bca312f893f4ca7f039c086bb43e6d7b4cb100aa5b4d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total sum of 19 numbers = 19 × 46 = 874

⇒ Sum of first 5 numbers = 5 × 49 = 245

⇒ Sum of next 6 numbers = 6 × 54 = 324

⇒ Number of remaining numbers = 19 − 5 − 6 = 8

⇒ Sum of remaining 8 numbers = Total sum − (Sum of first 5 + Sum of next 6)

⇒ Sum of remaining 8 numbers = 874 − (245 + 324) = 874 − 569 = 305

⇒ Average of remaining 8 numbers = 305 ÷ 8 = 38.125

⇒ Rounding to one decimal place, we get 38.1

**∴ The correct answer is 38.1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Net Deviation Method

The sum of deviations of all items from the true average is always zero. If a subset has a net positive deviation, the remaining items must have an equal negative deviation to bring the overall average back to balance.

Combined Average

When two groups of sizes n₁ and n₂ have averages A₁ and A₂ respectively, their combined average is calculated as: A = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Weighted Average

It is a type of average where each data point has a different weight or importance depending on its count. Formula: W.A. = (w₁x₁ + w₂x₂ + ... + wₙxₙ) ÷ (w₁ + w₂ + ... + wₙ).
